body: The three existing Focus pins from Linux and Mac Mini are now stored on their card files in .project and synchronized through Git. Both running daemons show the same three Focus cards and the same project tag catalog/version. Their card order remains local. Source validation passes on both hosts (43 documents, zero issues); the Mac Mini web and Rust release builds pass. Linux full gate and 11 Chromium regression suites passed before deployment. No physical iPhone or Safari check was performed.

metadata.summary: Source-backed Focus synchronized across Linux and Mac Mini
